text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 latency breach on streaming endpoint /v1/chat/stream across eu-west-1. p99 jumped to 4.2s, p95 at 1.8s. Autoscale healthy. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

alex: copying metrics: rolling 5m windows, spike started ~4123456770. streaming stalls correlate with increase in token generation time.

maria: seeing same in model telemetry — quant-profile rollout for int8->fp8 started 3m before spike. calibration job showed higher KL divergence on long-seq prefixes.

jordan: I'm the oncall, acked. Paging now. any customer-facing impact?

support-bot: Support alert: 3 customer sessions flagged degraded streaming (search-api, chat-widget). CS tickets auto-created #TCK-839, #TCK-840.

samir: quick triage: KV cache hit-rate stable. CPU fine, GPU util up slightly on some workers. Latency tail aligns with requests with >1024 context tokens. suspect quantization degradation on long KV replays.

priya: assign mitigation steps: 1) divert new streaming traffic to high-memory instance pool, 2) disable fp8 rollout, 3) enable fallback to baseline fp16 model.

alex: I can push routing rule now. command:```curl -X POST https://internal-routing/api/route -d '{"route":"streaming","pool":"high-mem","ttl":600}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTING_TOKEN"```

jordan: do it. also set canary=false for the quant profile in config service.

maria: how to disable fp8 rollout:```curl -X PATCH https://config.redwood/api/profiles/quant-rolling -d '{"active":false,"reason":"live tail latency"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CONFIG_TOKEN"```

samir: rolling rollback initiated on 6 nodes, waiting for drain. starting immediate model fallback for streaming route to fp16.

deploy-bot: deploy job started: rollback-quant-profile-4123456890 -> queued -> running on cluster-eu-3. logs: `rollback step1: patch profile; step2: restart agent; step3: validate`

alex: adding temporary request-level rate cap for chat-widget to reduce burstiness: `X-Redwood-Req-Limit: 20/s`

maria: telemetry update: after disabling fp8 rollout on 2 nodes p99 improved from 4.2s -> 2.1s for those nodes. global still elevated while rollbacks complete. p95 back under 1.2s for rollback nodes.

priya: customer-impact note: major SLAs affected: streaming p99 target 1.0s. Not breached for all customers, but 8% of sessions saw >3s tail. priority: stabilize tail for long-context jobs.

samir: observed weird dequant step hang in logs for affected workers. snippet:```[2026-03-15T12:11:33Z] worker-74 dequantize: waiting for kv-restore timeout=1500ms
[2026-03-15T12:11:34Z] worker-74 generate: stall at step 3/50, gpu-kernel queue backlog 128
``` Might be kernel choice mismatch after fp8 transform.

alex: synced with infra: will bump kernel-selection to conservative path for rolling nodes: set `kernel_mode=stable` in node config.

jordan: oncall handoff note: I'm taking active coordination, will stay until p99 < 1.2s for 15m. after that handoff to alex for followups.

support-bot: Customer comms prepared draft: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls impacting some long-context sessions. Mitigation in progress; rolling rollback of recent precision changes. We'll update in 30m." Approve?

priya: approve. also add ETA ~45m to full recovery initial estimate.

maria: postmortem seeds: include quant calibration unit tests, longer-tail evals, gating rules for rollout (min long-seq samples > 1000), and automatic rollback trigger on p99>1.5s.

samir: follow-ups: run a focused repro with long-seq synthetic load and toggled quant kernels. open ticket INFRA-1292.

alex: metrics now: global p99 down to 1.9s, p95 1.1s. rollout rollback ~70% complete.

jordan: good progress. leaving for 30m watch. handoff plan: if p99 stays <1.5s and tickets under threshold, hand to Alex. otherwise escalate to Priya.

priya: I'll coordinate post-incident actions and customer outreach. ops channel will get full writeup after stabilization.

support-bot: updating tickets with mitigation steps and customer message.

deploy-bot: rollback finished on all targeted nodes at 4123456881. validation: smoke-streaming-tests OK.

maria: final check: long-context regression reduced. starting calibration-sanity runs to verify no silent drift.

jordan: closing paging momentarily — still monitoring. final note: root cause likely quant-profile calibration fallout interacting with kernel selection for long-context KV restoration on fp8 path. mitigated by rollback + kernel conservative path.

priya: action items assigned: INFRA-1292 (repro), ML-431 (gating + tests), OPS-204 (customer comms follow-up). handing to alex for incident report writeup. :white_check_mark:
